name: Informative Dashboard EA
summary: This EA is a utility that creates and displays an informative dashboard panel on the MT5 chart. It does not execute any trades; instead, it renders a custom GUI panel with configurable position and size, refreshing its displayed values on every tick and handling user interaction via chart events.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个工具类程序，用于在MT5图表上创建和显示信息面板。它不执行任何交易操作，而是渲染一个可配置位置和尺寸的自定义GUI面板，每个tick刷新显示值，并通过图表事件处理用户交互。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略，而是一个信息展示仪表盘工具。它通过CInformativeDashboard类创建一个可视化面板，面板位置和尺寸由四个输入参数(x1_, y1_, x2_, y2_)控制。在OnInit中初始化并运行仪表盘，OnTick中调用RefreshValues()实时更新面板数据，OnChartEvent中转发用户交互事件给仪表盘处理，OnDeinit中销毁面板释放资源。由于核心逻辑封装在mqh头文件的类中，从EA本身无法判断具体展示哪些市场数据或指标，但架构设计清晰，采用了面向对象的方式封装仪表盘功能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but an informational dashboard utility. It creates a visual panel via the CInformativeDashboard class, with panel position and size controlled by four input parameters (x1_, y1_, x2_, y2_). The dashboard is initialized and launched in OnInit, values are refreshed in real-time via RefreshValues() on every tick, user interactions are forwarded to the dashboard through OnChartEvent, and resources are cleaned up in OnDeinit. Since the core logic is encapsulated in the .mqh header file class, the specific market data or indicators displayed cannot be determined from the EA alone, but the architecture is clean and uses object-oriented design to encapsulate dashboard functionality. Position sizing and money management are not applicable as this is a non-trading utility.
pros: 采用面向对象设计，核心逻辑封装在独立类中，代码结构清晰
生命周期管理完整，包含初始化、刷新、事件处理和销毁四个阶段
面板位置和尺寸可通过输入参数灵活配置，用户友好
通过OnChartEvent转发事件，支持用户与面板交互
pros_en: Object-oriented design with core logic encapsulated in a separate class, resulting in clean code structure
Complete lifecycle management covering initialization, refresh, event handling, and destruction
Panel position and size are flexibly configurable via input parameters, user-friendly
Event forwarding via OnChartEvent enables user interaction with the dashboard panel
cons: EA文件本身过于简单，所有核心逻辑隐藏在外部mqh文件中，无法独立审查完整功能
缺乏错误处理，如CreateDashboard和Run的返回值未检查
没有输入参数验证，用户可能输入无效的坐标值导致面板显示异常
缺少对仪表盘对象是否成功创建的验证
cons_en: The EA file itself is overly simplistic with all core logic hidden in an external .mqh file, making full functionality review impossible from this file alone
No error handling — return values of CreateDashboard and Run are not checked
No input parameter validation — invalid coordinate values could cause abnormal panel display
Missing verification of whether dashboard objects were successfully created
improvements: 增加错误处理和返回值检查，确保仪表盘创建和运行成功
添加输入参数范围验证，防止无效坐标导致显示问题
improvements_en: Add error handling and return value checks to ensure dashboard creation and execution succeed
Add input parameter range validation to prevent display issues from invalid coordinates

risk_points: 不执行任何交易操作，无资金风险
核心逻辑封装在外部文件中，需确保mqh文件来源可信
risk_points_en: No trading operations executed, no financial risk
Core logic is encapsulated in an external file — must ensure the .mqh file source is trustworthy
